reason: A Linux Electron desktop launcher that starts or reuses the local DeepSeek Harness Web service and presents it in a dedicated application window.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 网页服务封装为 Linux 桌面应用，自动管理本地服务并在独立窗口中打开界面。
summaries.en: A Linux desktop application that manages a local DeepSeek Harness Web service and opens its interface in a dedicated Electron window.

capabilities: Launches and manages a local DSH Web service process
Loads a local web interface in an Electron application window
Writes application files and desktop launcher files during installation
Reads configurable local host, port, command, and application directory settings
